goals: Provide Silver Birch, Wisteria and Sweet Violets as separate Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric content using supplied private textures.
Preserve target-version tree shapes and density while replacing old-growth birch materials and selecting 25% Wisteria in cherry groves.
scope: Nine block/item identities, direct vanilla plank recipes, all-bark wood recipes, vanilla axe stripping, tool-gated leaf collection, leaf-to-sapling recipes, composting and normal sapling behavior.
Loaded tree/fallen-tree material substitution preserves shape parameters and applicable decorators; biome-scoped selectors cover standing/fallen birch variants and weighted cherry/Wisteria attempts.

Preferred tree-associated Sweet Violets with a bounded successful-growth decorator; remove the independent grove petal pass; retain Nemo ordinary cherry and unrelated decorators without a required Nemo dependency.

Position-dependent golden Silver Birch leaf tint, a normal cube leaf item with one matching default golden tint, #B0C73A old-growth grass tint, separately namespaced Wisteria particles, and the standalone user-supplied Wisteria log-top texture.

Optional client Iris material-map fallback for only the two custom leaf species: inherit loaded vanilla birch/cherry state IDs only when no explicit custom mapping exists; no shader-pack/profile edits or fake animation.

Client-only soil-dependent base bark on upright Silver Birch log sides, using the exact supplied packaged texture and extensible silver_birch_base_soils block tag; ordinary items and live vanilla birch end grain remain. Contextual geometry keys and resource/tag/neighbor rebuild handling preserve current placed trees without saved-state changes.

exclusions: No new planks, custom stripped blocks, additional wood families, biomes, RU world generation, runtime RU dependency, CTM base-log block or bushy/drooping geometry.
No runtime deployment, slot changes, retrogen, existing-tree conversion, profile mutation or protected gameplay-instance access.
No redistribution of supplied restricted pixels, reference binaries or privately retained artifact.

dependencies.reason: Exact target for audited tree data and APIs.
Block, biome, content registry, creative-tab, client tint and particle APIs.

state.milestone: Canary 3 implements soil-dependent upright Silver Birch base bark, with six default soils, ordinary item fallback and contextual geometry/reload handling; clean build passes 23 Java and 16 Python checks. Exact private artifact retained. ACTIVE / NOT_DEPLOYED / RUNTIME_UNTESTED; obsolete overlay CTM rule must be removed separately before managed visual testing.
